Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Pear Tree Farm Animal Sanctuary 💚

We are a small, independent, volunteer-run animal sanctuary in Somerset, UK, providing lifelong care, safety and second chances to rescued animals.

Follow the lives of our residents, hear their rescue stories, enjoy behind-the-scenes sanctuary updates and join us as we work to create a kinder future for animals.

Since 2018, we have helped more than 7,500 animals, with over 80 residents now calling Pear Tree home, including pigs, horses, goats, sheep, poultry, rabbits, ferrets, cats and dogs.

Subscribe and become part of our sanctuary family!
